params.body: Measured with #180 on staging: the vehicle detail page took 3.9 s of which 125 ms database. The rest was RealGarantService::isConnected(): a live login at RealGarant (POST /rest/auth) on every detail page, every list render and every offer screen, because the token lived only on the service instance. Now cached per dealer for fifteen minutes; a failed login is remembered for one minute; getToken(true) forces a fresh login (used by the refreshToken path). Expected: detail page from 3.9 s to well under 0.5 s.
params.title: RealGarant: cached login token (detail page was 3.9 s)
